material_fixes.finding: Home attention monopolizes the first viewport and hides the multi-project overview.
evidence: docs/evidence/a65-prototype/final/pc-light-home.png: entire 1280x900 viewport; attention panel y355–844, no Projects visible
docs/evidence/a65-prototype/final/pc-dark-home.png: Projects heading near y918, project rows below viewport
docs/evidence/a65-prototype/final/pc-dark-home-full.png: Projects below full-width eight-row attention preview
material_fixes.why: The approved primary experience is rapid control across several projects. The entire visible working area repeats one unverified-execution reason; the two-column work/projects arrangement begins too late.
material_fixes.user_consequence: A user cannot compare project identities and current per-project state on entry; the home reads as a long exception queue.
material_fixes.bounded_fix: Rebalance the existing home composition in one batch: cap the attention preview to a compact first page, preserve independent next/previous or all-item access, and compact the existing project identity/count/status rows while keeping paths available as secondary information. Preserve attention → work → projects → activity reading order. At 1280x900 and 1440x1000, show the three synthetic project identities and their current state/counts in the first viewport, with attention remaining the strongest section. Do not add metrics or reorder into a Pane clone.
material_fixes.acceptance: Same-data desktop recaptures visibly show all three project identities and state/counts before the fold; all attention records remain reachable and truthful.

material_fixes.finding: The 320px English attention row reserves most horizontal width for its status badge.
material_fixes.promise: FORM / equal mobile function / craft-floor real-copy responsive composition
evidence: docs/evidence/a65-prototype/final/mobile-light-home.png: first attention card y438–663; title/reason confined to roughly x36–130 while the arrow sits near x262
docs/evidence/a65-prototype/final/mobile-wide-home.png: comparison showing a much wider usable text measure
goassets/template/_task_mecca/framework/web/ui/smoke.css:983: 1fr auto grid; task-main restricted to column 1, status occupies auto column 2
material_fixes.why: The long English state label determines the second grid column for every row. The title and reason wrap into a narrow strip although there is unused width below the badge. Document-overflow checks cannot detect this.
material_fixes.user_consequence: At the explicitly supported 320px width, the reason requires excessive vertical reading and each item becomes much harder to scan than on wider mobile.
material_fixes.bounded_fix: Make the mobile metadata line and content width independent: retain ID and status on a compact upper line, then let title, project and reason span the usable row width with a small trailing chevron allocation. Allow the status to wrap or occupy its own line when necessary. Keep the complete reason accessible; do not solve this by reducing the font or truncating the evidence.
material_fixes.acceptance: The same 320px English first card uses almost the full card width for title/reason; 390px Korean and 430px English remain legible with no badge/arrow overlap.

material_fixes.finding: Mobile backlog auxiliary controls consume the task-reading viewport.
material_fixes.promise: Approved mobile compact-tools requirement / FORM / craft-floor coverage
evidence: docs/evidence/a65-prototype/final/mobile-light-backlog.png: expanded form y302–518; first task begins around y632, above bottom navigation y763
docs/evidence/a65-prototype/final/mobile-dark-backlog.png: expanded form y281–499; first task begins around y595
docs/evidence/a65-prototype/final/mobile-wide-backlog.png: expanded state/sort/page-size controls and full-width Apply above task list
goassets/template/_task_mecca/framework/web/ui/smoke.css:1064: mobile wrapping of all filter controls
material_fixes.why: The approved plan explicitly says mobile auxiliary tools should fold so that the work area is not pushed down. Wrapping every control into additional rows does not meet that behavior.
material_fixes.user_consequence: Only one task or part of one task is available on initial mobile entry, and users repeatedly scroll through settings to reach their work.
material_fixes.bounded_fix: Keep search immediately available and place state/sort/page-size and tag options in a concise accessible disclosure with a visible active-filter summary. Preserve every current control, query state, URL restoration and keyboard/touch access. Compact the existing path/context presentation if needed. Do not introduce a modal.
material_fixes.acceptance: At 320/390/430px, the collapsed default backlog visibly provides search, a discoverable filters action, and at least one complete task row above bottom navigation. Open-state captures prove all existing controls remain usable and active filters remain visible.

material_fixes.finding: Backlog rows omit every temporal fact.
material_fixes.promise: Approved backlog name/state/assignee/time priority / craft-floor coverage
evidence: docs/evidence/a65-prototype/final/pc-dark-backlog.png: rows show ID/title/assignee/state without a time
goassets/template/_task_mecca/framework/web/ui/screens/detail.js: executionMetadata already reads updated_at or mtime
material_fixes.why: Time is explicitly part of the approved core list hierarchy, not a next-stage operations feature. The shared row template has no temporal rendering branch at all.
material_fixes.user_consequence: Users must open tasks to determine recency, even when comparing a backlog sorted by recent modification.
material_fixes.bounded_fix: Render one clearly labeled existing temporal fact in backlog rows, preferably the available Updated timestamp from updated_at/mtime, with an explicit Unknown value when absent. Keep it secondary to title/state and retain assignee. Never label modification time as measured activity or fabricate duration. Fit it into the same responsive row repair.
material_fixes.acceptance: Desktop and mobile backlog recaptures show truthful labeled recency or Unknown on each row without sacrificing title, assignee or state; no temporal value is synthesized.

keep: Preserve original mark, factual uncertainty and provenance, compact neutral Smoke reflections/soft depth, restrained blue, dedicated detail navigation, connected lifecycle behavior, and all current list/state restoration; no new features or direction change.
